propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is superseded by per-class model configuration (model_classes) and must be deprecated with a scheduled removal window rather than kept as permanent alias
deprecation warnings must be emitted at both env read sites (config.py line 469 and model_classes.py) to catch all code paths that resolve the model without touching the other site
when REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no class-specific models are configured, it must map to all three classes (FRONTIER, JUDGE, ASSESSOR) for backward compatibility during the migration window

documentation and user-facing strings must be updated across six prose files and four rendered references to present per-class model configuration as the current interface and mark REBAR_LLM_MODEL as deprecated
complete example configs for each provider pattern (Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, local+fallback) must be added to docs to ease operator migration from env var to class configuration
an ADR must document the class-based model configuration design, the deprecation window rationale, and rejected alternatives
